claim: Connect technology cost curves and adoption to addressable market, company capture, unit economics and an explicit five-year valuation distribution.
Fit versioned cost and adoption curves with uncertainty bands.
Translate sector adoption into company revenue, cash needs and valuation scenarios.
Reject when sector growth has no evidenced bridge to company cash flows.
Reject when required funding and dilution cannot be bounded.
Reject constructive output when price requires adoption beyond the reviewed scenario range.
Excluded claim: current ARK trades not established by dated public records
Excluded claim: single-path five-year price targets
Known limit: Fund holdings disclose positions but not the complete decision process or intra-period trading rationale.
Known limit: Published thematic models may change; version and as-of discipline is required to prevent hindsight substitution.
